title: MUA: Mobile Ultra-detailed Animatable Avatars
summary: MUA is a mobile-optimized framework for rendering high-fidelity digital humans with complex clothing dynamics. It distills server-grade visual quality into a lightweight format capable of running at 24 FPS on standalone hardware like Meta Quest 3.
research_notes: Achieves over 180 FPS on desktop hardware and 24 FPS on Meta Quest 3; supports dynamic relighting and self-shadowing.

evolution.summary: Developed as the mobile-ready 'student' model of the high-end UMA project, MUA reduces computational costs by 2000x. It uses wavelet spectral decomposition to maintain extreme skin and clothing detail while achieving real-time performance on mobile GPUs.
